semantic_review.domain_ownership: Ownership, duplicate, eligibility, version comparison and email availability remain Domain policies. Application sequences them with first-match validation and owns its enclosing commit. Domain factories perform no I/O. Source: domain/policies.py, domain/models.py, application/enroll.py, application/student_details.py.
semantic_review.identity_confirmation: Session.create_enrollment, StudentSession.create_student and prerequisite provisioning acknowledge actual business-table INSERTs and obtain stored natural/composite identity before Entity.create. Reads decode Value Objects through create and invoke Entity.reconstitute. Student versions are metadata, not identities. No reservation table, lifetime handle, generated identity Port or management endpoint was added.
semantic_review.operation_confinement: Pending enrollment/snapshot results are local to the use-case try block; successful external return follows commit and cleanup. Repository methods never COMMIT independently. Real Repository contracts inspect uncommitted rows and prove preceding/following writes roll back.
semantic_review.failures_and_reconciliation: Explicit Domain rejection and exceptions cancel uncommitted writes. Known SQL faults become Core StorageFailure; corruption becomes DataIntegrityFailure. Cleanup preserves an already propagating primary exception. Ambiguous COMMIT returns completion failure and independently readable committed rows survive without compensation. Confirmed-response serialization loss also leaves committed rows intact.
semantic_review.replacement_order: StudentId, ProgrammeId, name, email, mode and expected-version representation precede persistence. Existence precedes Domain version comparison, which precedes email availability. One UPDATE matches identity and expected version, advances the version, and writes complete details. No silent replay, unconditional replacement or ABA token reuse is introduced.
semantic_review.restoration: Student restoration validates required text and saved versions without requiring programme existence. Historical enrollments restore without replaying current admission eligibility. Enrollment never writes Student details or saved versions.
semantic_review.boundary_isolation: Core Ports and values remain infrastructure-free. HTTP/GraphQL and identity adapters convert representations; SQL functions delegate required-text and email semantics to Domain. Entity construction call sites remain restricted to Repository implementations; ordinary callers use Value Object factories.
semantic_review.evidence_chronology: Eight required cohesive increments have associated state-stable, nonoverlapping ordered behavioral Red/Green executions. T192 retains an acceptance failure returning STUDENT_STORAGE_FAILURE before the real Repository constraint failures and schema-refusal failure; these preceded the schema correction. Relevant acceptance/inner Green and refactor runs pass. The existing fully associated v300-gates Red uses pytest DID NOT RAISE; the rejected preliminary executable-only record remains diagnostic and cannot certify a required cycle.
semantic_review.exact_identifiers: T192 changes all eight identifier CHECK expressions across the five business tables to retain typeof(TEXT) enforcement and measure nonempty BLOB byte length. NUL-only, leading-NUL and embedded-NUL identities retain exact values through committed Student create/read/conditional replacement and HTTP GraphQL enrollment. Repository provisioning/restoration covers all five tables. Domain factories already accepted these values and were not changed; their passing cases are verification, not invented Domain Red. Empty/NULL/BLOB constraints, keys, foreign keys, email uniqueness and saved-version checks remain covered. Initialization refuses the former TEXT-length schema byte-for-byte unchanged; no migration/backfill occurs.
